entries.en: Serendipity is quite pleased to see you.
entries.fr: À en juger par l'expression sur le visage de Serendipity, elle doit avoir une nouvelle besogne à vous donner.
entries.ja: 彫金師ギルドのセレンディピティーは、冒険者に仕事を紹介したいようだ。

entries.en: Roroton, the merchant for whom you previously crafted a pair of malachite earrings, has commissioned you to make a fire brand of peerless quality. Craft the item to the best of your ability and present it to Serendipity for inspection.
entries.fr: Roroton a passé une nouvelle commande à la guilde. Il vous faudra cette fois ouvrager <frnoun(ItemHQ,1,　2078,1,1)> et la remettre à Serendipity.
entries.ja: セレンディピティーから依頼を受けた。ウルダハの彫金師ギルドにいる「セレンディピティー」に「<sheet(ItemHQ,　2078,0)>」を納品しよう。

entries.en:
As usual, Gigi assists with the evaluation of your work. However, in an unusual turn of events, your fire brand appears to trigger bizarre pyromaniac tendencies hidden deep within the mammet's soul. Nevertheless, Serendipity assures you that there is no need for concern, and that she will see that Roroton receives his order without incident.

※The next goldsmith quest will be available from Serendipity upon reaching level 40.
